interpretation.conditional_prediction: same_rule_candidate_stage is derived from positive-integer operand readiness and the retained-result rule, conditional on extending the frontier to that stage. It is not an observed stage beyond the saved checkpoint; null means this named certificate cannot be completed without changing an operand or retention assumption.
interpretation.lineage_vs_norm: A witnessed transition can precede its direct target-shell certificate, or produce a negative output whose next reuse is forbidden. These are joint certificate availability stages, not chronological execution traces; scalar inputs may exist by other routes before the preceding selected transition completes.
interpretation.node_presence: A target value can exist via unrelated operations while the selected spiral transition is blocked.
interpretation.ordered_orientation: Swapping seed coordinates changes signed iterates; taking absolute values would change the repeated construction.
interpretation.retention: Narrow-source literal seed shells can be unwitnessed despite coordinate nodes being present; this is a retained-edge aperture limitation.
interpretation.selection: The frozen reviewed index used for historical comparison selects only seed(4,3,5) and its sequential scalar_lineage criterion. Missing seed/split associations are selection limits, even where SQL supplies complete alternative construction support. This does not describe any later parameterized builder.
interpretation.split_criteria: scalar_only asks only for the seven pair-product requests. with_selected_source_lineages additionally binds each source to its seed power; with_direct_source_shells instead requires direct literal source norm certificates. These are different criteria. A failed sequential route is not a proof that the power has no other supported construction.

method: Independent exact pair multiplication and direct SQLite witness queries. No profile selector/support functions or tests are used for truth; saved profile claims are compared afterward.
scope: One fixed seed, its coordinate-swapped control and scale-two control. Sequential lineage is inspected through its first incomplete step; every ordered split i+j=n for2<=n<=4 is separately inspected. No claim of all spirals, all algebraic rewrites, or a new timing law.
